9a076bb3cb02af36c7702d3b15c6bc7977c8ba19.summary: Cybernews reports that the BlackCat (ALPHV) ransomware gang added NJVC, an IT company supporting US government and defense organisations, to its leak site on 28 September 2022. The gang first said it would release NJVC's data in stages, then removed the victim. NJVC did not reply to a request for comment. The article also cites activity statistics for the group and a $4.5 million ransom demand against the University of Pisa.

9abf08d5f161141853b1ecf23b0b35d6839adb64.summary: Morphisec profile of the FIN7 JSSLoader, a minimized .NET remote access trojan mostly used by FIN7 (Carbanak Group). It covers JSSLoader versions from October 2019 to December 2020 and phishing lures that deliver VBScript or WSF first stages, which fetch JSSLoader and run it via a scheduled task. Listed capabilities include anti-debugging, data collection, persistence, auto-update and remote commands, one of which runs a Takeout PowerShell script that loads Carbanak. The report notes resemblance to QBOT and possible Egregor links.
